notes.subject: ⟨motho⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew has no expressed subject for האמר ('hath any said'); Sepedi needs one.

notes.subject: נשאתי
notes.rationale: 'I have borne (chastisement)' (KJV, JPS) vs YLT 'I have taken away' vs Geneva 'I have pardoned' — the verb נשא spans lift/bear/forgive.

notes.subject: אחבל
notes.rationale: 'I will not offend again' (KJV) vs 'I will not corrupt' (YLT) vs 'though I offend not' (JPS negation question).

translation: Gore go El ⟨motho⟩ a bolela: Ke boreletše, nka se hlole go šinya.
